notes:
Downloaded directly from the link published on alrajhi bank's own official Investor Relations page (https://www.alrajhibank.com.sa/en/About-alrajhi-bank/Investor-Relations, confirmed 2026-09-11) -- primary source, not a third-party aggregator. SHA-256 e66e4adfe206deef5b561d61f736be0b9b67d772a0203757a45f0a0ea439de42, 13,942,086 bytes, 432 pages. filed_at uses the PDF's own last-modified metadata timestamp (2026-04-02T18:05:07+05:30) as a proxy publication date since the integrated annual report itself carries no explicit board-approval line the way the audited financial statements do; the audited FY2025 statements (data/imports/alrajhi-2025-fy.json) were filed 2026-02-04, a few weeks earlier, which is consistent. All facts below were read directly from the archived PDF with PyMuPDF text extraction (digital text, not scanned) and cross-checked against the page cited. Every historical/current figure here (five-year summary, segment table, KPIs) reconciles with or duplicates figures already in the audited-statements manifest and alrajhi-supplement.json where they overlap; nothing here was invented.

disclosures.title: alrajhi bank Integrated Annual Report 2025
disclosures.body_text: Integrated annual report covering company profile, strategy, business portfolio, sustainability, corporate governance, risk management and audited consolidated financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2025.

disclosures.title: Top 10 risks for 2025 (bank-identified, scorecard-ranked)
disclosures.body_text: Funding & Liquidity Risk; Cyber Risk and Financial Crime; Operational Risk; Compliance Risk; Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity Management; Talent Risk; Data Governance & Privacy; Business Digitalisation Risk & Change Management; Credit Risk; Regulatory Changes Risk. The bank states credit risk remained the largest single risk category given its retail-focused portfolio, though comparatively low versus peers.

disclosures.title: Emerging risks for 2025 (bank-identified)
disclosures.body_text: ESG Risk (climate-related physical and transition risk embedded across the credit life cycle); Geopolitical Risk (escalation disrupting oil production/export capacity); Changing Consumer Behaviour Risk; Gap Risk (liquidity and repricing gaps from funding needs and rate expectations); Capital Adequacy Risk (breaching minimum CAR could trigger SAMA intervention).
